description: Dart source file defining the main presentation screen widget of the ReAct Agent Flutter application. Contains UI components, state management, and interactions for the agent interface.

classes.name: ReactAgentScreen
classes.description: Main widget for the React Agent app's screen, manages state and UI for interactions and step display.

classes.name: _ReactAgentScreenState
classes.description: State class for ReactAgentScreen, manages controllers, UI updates, and interactions.

classes.name: _DebugOverlayPanel
classes.description: Debug overlay widget that shows internal state and logs for debugging purposes.

classes.description: A small widget displaying debug information as a styled chip.

classes.name: _PrimaryActionButton
classes.description: A custom styled button with gradient background used for starting the agent.

methods.description: Initializes controllers and sets up listener for step changes.

methods.description: Handles updates when the controller's steps change, including auto-scrolling.
